name: TDspAudioLoop
description: Audio-domain loop recorder: tdsp::AudioLooper, a stereo AudioStream_F32 node that captures the device's digital audio into an int16 loop, bar-locked to the master Clock, with an equal-power overlap-crossfade at the seam for click-free loops. Overdub + clock-follow. Sibling of the MIDI-domain lib/TDspMidiLoop. PROTOTYPE.
